# The Standard

> > London's leading news and lifestyle publication covering UK politics, international affairs, culture, business, and consumer shopping guides.

The Standard (formerly Evening Standard) delivers comprehensive coverage of London life alongside national and global news, with particular focus on UK politics, Middle East affairs (especially Iran and the Strait of Hormuz), cultural events, and curated shopping recommendations. The publication serves as both a news source and lifestyle guide for London audiences.

## Key Topics

- London news and culture
- UK politics and government
- Iran and Strait of Hormuz crisis
- Middle East affairs
- Shopping guides and product reviews
- Theatre and West End
- Celebrity and entertainment news
- Business and finance
- Health and beauty
- Outdoor living and BBQ
- Transport and travel
- Sports coverage
- Parliamentary accountability
- Consumer recommendations

- [Iran conflict creating 'largest oil supply disruption in history', says IEA](https://www.standard.co.uk/business/business-news/iran-strait-of-hormuz-middle-east-brent-israeli-b1274593.html): IEA warns Iran's Strait of Hormuz blockade causes historic oil disruption
